title: Fastweb + Vodafone's support agent resolves 82% of queries for 9.5M customers
summary: Fastweb + Vodafone built a LangGraph customer-service agent for nearly 9.5 million customers; the company reports 90% correctness and an 82% resolution rate.
agent_role: Agents answer and resolve customer requests and assist human operators; call-center staff handle escalations and the team monitors quality through evaluations.
outcome: Super TOBi: 90% correctness, 82% resolution rate, Customer Effort Score 5.2/7; Super Agent: one-call resolution above 86%
what_they_did: Fastweb + Vodafone, an Italian telco, rebuilt its TOBi chatbot as Super TOBi using LangGraph. A Supervisor agent applies guardrails, handles handovers and routes queries to specialized Use Case agents that call customer APIs and can trigger actions such as offer activation or payment updates. A second system, Super Agent, helps call-center consultants by running troubleshooting procedures stored as a Neo4j knowledge graph. LangSmith is used for tracing and evaluation.
how_it_went: The company reports Super TOBi serves nearly 9.5 million customers with 90% correctness, an 82% resolution rate and a Customer Effort Score of 5.2 out of 7. It says Super Agent pushed one-call resolution above 86%.
worth_knowing: Super Agent never talks to customers directly; it gives the human consultant the next step. Business specialists write procedures in structured templates that a pipeline turns into graph nodes, reaching production within hours.
prompt: Help me design a LangGraph customer-support agent for [your business]. Start with a Supervisor node that filters unsafe or invalid input, handles greetings and handovers to a human, and routes each question to one of these use cases: [list of use cases, e.g. billing, account changes]. For each use case, define which [your APIs or data sources] it may call and what it should answer. Any action that changes an account, such as a payment or a cancellation, must be shown to the customer or a staff member for confirmation before it runs. Show me the graph design and a test plan with sample conversations, and wait for my approval before writing code.
